text:
arjun: FYI onboarding smoke failed. Our JS sampleapp ran embeddings -> rerank and downstream retriever threw because vectors were 512 instead of 768.

meera: ugh. Which SDK + helper? any headers?

arjun: node sdk v0.9.2 using batching helper, default config (no explicit fallback_model). Minimal call: 
```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/rerank-1', input: ['A','B'], batch_size: 2, retry: { max_attempts: 2 } })
```
Response excerpt (trimmed):
```json
{ "model": "redwood/rerank-1", "embeddings": [[...]], "embedding_dim": 512 }
```
headers included x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-slim, x-retry-count: 1.

claire: that screams fallback variant. Did the helper retry on a 429 and swap to a cheaper model?

arjun: yes. I only spotted it because similarity scores were way off.

tom: note: python helper didn't show this in our test runs. Parity gap: node batching helper had a default fallback set last sprint; python used a different config key so it didn't use the fallback.

meera: two problems then: 1) implicit fallback can change embedding dim, 2) SDK parity makes only some sampleapps hit it. Any quick workarounds for customers?

claire: immediate: pass retry: { fallback_model: null } to disable auto-fallback, or retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' } to force same model on retry. Also add a shape assertion before using vectors. Something like: 
```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.create(...)
const vecs = resp.embeddings || resp.vectors || []
const dim = resp.embedding_dim || resp.dim || (vecs[0] && vecs[0].length)
if (!vecs.length) throw new Error('empty embeddings')
if (dim !== 768) throw new Error(`unexpected embedding dim ${dim}`)
```
That should make failures loud.

arjun: good. I'll push that to the sampleapp.

tom: also found a second bug: node helper silently normalized empty bodies into an empty embeddings array on a 200. Python throws. We should fail on empty embedding bodies.

meera: agree. We should also surface x-redwood-model-variant as response.model_variant in all SDKs so app logs can show which variant returned.

claire: created ticket DEVEX-4500 to: remove implicit node fallback default, make helper error on empty body, and add model_variant to SDK response. PR #6112 queued.

sdk-bot: CI run triggered for PR #6112  tests: sdk-unit + sampleapp-smoke (staging).

meera: docs action: add short FAQ entry "Why did my embedding dim change?" with recommended checks and the fallback_model config example.

docs-bot: Created docs task DOC-121 to add FAQ and sample polyfill snippet.

arjun: confirmed local fix with explicit fallback_model: null -> vectors back to 768, and the shape assertion caught an earlier empty-body case. I'll send a tiny PR to onboarding quickstart.

claire: after PR lands let's run automated smoke across node/python/rust sampleapps to verify parity for keys (embeddings vs vectors) and shape handling.

meera: thanks all. Leaving this open until DEVEX-4500 merged and sampleapps updated. :thumbsup:
